# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: Age response logistic regression
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[1], header = TRUE, sep = "	", quote = "", check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
required <- c("Efficacy", "Age")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns Efficacy and Age were not found")
eff <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["Age"]]))
allowed <- eff %in% c("PR", "SD", "PD")
if (any(!allowed & !is.na(eff) & nzchar(eff))) stop("Unexpected Efficacy level")
y <- ifelse(eff == "PR", 1, 0)
keep <- allowed & complete.cases(age, y)
if (sum(keep) < 3) stop("Too few complete observations")
if (length(unique(y[keep])) != 2) stop("Response is not binary after coding")
fit <- glm(y[keep] ~ age[keep], family = binomial(link = "logit"))
if (!isTRUE(fit[["converged"]])) stop("Logistic regression did not converge")
sm <- summary(fit)[["coefficients"]]
out <- data.frame(term = "Age",
                  estimate = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
                  std_error = unname(sm[2, "Std. Error"]),
                  z_value = unname(sm[2, "z value"]),
                  p_value = unname(sm[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
options(digits = 17)
write.table(out, file = "coefficient.tsv", sep = "	", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
diag <- data.frame(method = "R glm binomial logit maximum likelihood",
                   formula = "I(Efficacy == PR) ~ Age",
                   event = "PR",
                   reference = "SD/PD",
                   input_rows = nrow(d),
                   complete_rows = sum(keep),
                   event_count = sum(y[keep] == 1),
                   nonevent_count = sum(y[keep] == 0),
                   converged = fit[["converged"]],
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(diag, file = "model_diagnostics.tsv", sep = "	", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: Simple logistic regression: age and camrelizumab response
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one input path")
d <- read.delim(args[[1]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                strip.white = TRUE)
required <- c("Efficacy", "Age")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns: Efficacy and/or Age")
keep <- complete.cases(d[, required]) & d[["Efficacy"]] %in% c("PR", "SD", "PD")
m <- d[keep, required, drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(m) == 0L) stop("No evaluable rows")
if (!all(sort(unique(m[["Efficacy"]])) == sort(c("PR", "SD", "PD")))) {
  stop("Unexpected or missing efficacy categories")
}
m[["Response"]] <- as.integer(m[["Efficacy"]] == "PR")
fit <- glm(Response ~ Age, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = m)
s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
if (!("Age" %in% rownames(s))) stop("Age coefficient was not fitted")
out <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(s),
  estimate = s[, "Estimate"],
  std_error = s[, "Std. Error"],
  z_value = s[, "z value"],
  p_value = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  n = nrow(m),
  response_count = sum(m[["Response"]] == 1L),
  nonresponse_count = sum(m[["Response"]] == 0L),
  event = "PR",
  reference = "SD_or_PD",
  formula = "Response ~ Age",
  family = "binomial_logit_MLE",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
options(digits = 17)
write.table(out, file = "logistic_coefficients.tsv", sep = "	",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript job.R "$(inputs.input.path)"
